_comment: Copy to backend/mcp.json and edit the absolute paths. mcp.json is gitignored. The manager applies a read-only filter by default; 'tools' is an explicit allowlist (only these pass), 'deny' blocks by name. uvx servers pin 'mcp<2' because the published fetch/time/git servers target the mcp 1.x API while the client uses mcp 2.x.
